context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 98 validated the new Backup System feature. Backend endpoints: POST /api/admin/backup/criar (creates ~65MB .zip with all 51 collections + uploads), GET /api/admin/backup/historico (lists backups with arquivo_disponivel flag), GET /api/admin/backup/download/{id} (streams .zip file), DELETE /api/admin/backup/{id} (removes file + DB record), GET /api/admin/backup/info (system stats). Frontend: DashboardBackup.jsx shows 4 stat cards, 'Fazer Backup' button, backup history with download/delete buttons. Security: Only super_admin can access (role=='super_admin' OR tipo_admin=='Super Admin'). Backups stored in /app/backups/ directory. APScheduler job 'backup_semanal_quarta' runs every Wednesday at 02:30h.
